title: Foreshore route of the one-way loop: Bridge Tce, north Flinders Pde, Coral St
why: The council's clockwise one-way loop sends Hindmarsh Rd / Eyre Tce traffic, trucks and caravans included, along Bridge Tce and the north end of Flinders Pde into Coral St.
